EXPLANATION: Spectrum shows both aromatic-(3048, 3031 cm⁻¹) and aliphatic-CH stretches (2971, 2879 cm⁻¹), strong ring C=C band at 1622 cm⁻¹ and a conjugated C=O/C=C band near 1643 cm⁻¹, consistent with an α,β-unsaturated ketone fused to an aromatic ring. Characteristic benzene ring breathing (1003, 1023 cm⁻¹) and out-of-plane C–H bends at 817, 758 and 672 cm⁻¹ match a fused benzene system such as indanone. Among candidates, only 1 (O=C1CC=C2CC=CC12, an indan-1-one) contains a conjugated ketone fused to an aromatic ring without additional hetero groups that would generate other diagnostic bands (e.g., OH, NH, NO). Therefore candidate 1 best matches the observed peak pattern.
